An interface to the 'fastText'
\<<https://github.com/facebookresearch/fastText>\> library for efficient
learning of word representations and sentence classification. The
'fastText' algorithm is explained in detail in (i) "Enriching Word
Vectors with subword Information", Piotr Bojanowski, Edouard Grave,
Armand Joulin, Tomas Mikolov, 2017,
\<[doi:10.1162/tacl_a_00051](https://doi.org/10.1162/tacl_a_00051)\>;
(ii) "Bag of Tricks for Efficient Text Classification", Armand Joulin,
Edouard Grave, Piotr Bojanowski, Tomas Mikolov, 2017,
\<[doi:10.18653/v1/e17-2068](https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/e17-2068)\>;
(iii) "FastText.zip: Compressing text classification models", Armand
Joulin, Edouard Grave, Piotr Bojanowski, Matthijs Douze, Herve Jegou,
Tomas Mikolov, 2016,
\<[doi:10.48550/arXiv.1612.03651](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1612.03651)\>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`fasttext_interface()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/fasttext_interface.md)
  : Interface for the fasttext library
- [`language_identification()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/language_identification.md)
  : Language Identification using fastText
- [`plot_progress_logs()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/plot_progress_logs.md)
  : Plot the progress of loss, learning-rate and word-counts
- [`printAnalogiesUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printAnalogiesUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to 'analogies'
- [`printDumpUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printDumpUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to 'dump'
- [`printNNUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printNNUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to 'nn'
- [`printPredictUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printPredictUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to 'predict' or
  'predict-prob'
- [`printPrintNgramsUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printPrintNgramsUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to 'print-ngrams'
- [`printPrintSentenceVectorsUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printPrintSentenceVectorsUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to
  'print-sentence-vectors'
- [`printPrintWordVectorsUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printPrintWordVectorsUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to
  'print-word-vectors'
- [`printQuantizeUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printQuantizeUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to 'quantize'
- [`printTestLabelUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printTestLabelUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to 'test-label'
- [`printTestUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printTestUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information when the command equals to 'test'
- [`printUsage()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/printUsage.md)
  : Print Usage Information for all parameters
- [`print_parameters()`](https://mlampros.github.io/fastText/reference/print_parameters.md)
  : Print the parameters for a specific command
